name: Airbnb Stays
author: John Jahn
description: Find somewhere to stay without leaving your trip — search Airbnb for your dates, compare prices and ratings, and add the winner to the plan in one tap.

settings.label: OAuth authorize URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service — type the greyed-out value exactly as shown. Change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth token URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service — type the greyed-out value exactly as shown. Change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth client id
settings.hint: Run `npm run register -- <your TREK URL>` in the plugin repo once, then paste the client id it prints. Unique to this TREK instance.

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.hint: From the same command. Stored encrypted; never leaves this server.

settings.label: OpenBnB MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank to use the hosted OpenBnB service; the plugin falls back to the value shown.

settings.label: Map tiles
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank for OpenStreetMap, which needs no key. Point it elsewhere and add that host under Allowed hosts.

settings.label: Map tiles (dark theme)
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank to reuse the light-theme tiles.

settings.label: Map attribution
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank for the OpenStreetMap credit. Change it if you change the tile source — most providers require their own.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks this instance’s OpenBnB settings end to end and names the first thing that is wrong.
